summary:
## [1.7.1] - 2026-11-27

Release 1.7.1. One fix: a DirecTV receiver that was asked for its guide and scanned at the same time stopped
answering its own remote for a while. Not yet run against a receiver on site: the pause between requests was chosen
from one venue's report, and the automated tests drive a stand-in receiver.

### Fixed

- **DirecTV receivers are asked more gently.** Background questions to a receiver (the guide fill, the now-playing
  poll, a lineup scan) are now half a second apart instead of 150 ms, because a box asked several times a second for
  minutes stopped answering its own remote. Staff commands no longer wait out that pause. Starting a receiver scan
  drops the guide requests still queued for that box, and guide refreshes of every lineup read from it wait until the
  scan ends.
